Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
refactor: remove legacy node-cipher code

Remove the 833-line NodeCipher class that was copied from node-cipher repo.
This code had several security issues:
- Static salt \(''nodecipher''\) enabling rainbow table attacks
- Only 1,000 PBKDF2 iterations \(OWASP recommends 600,000\)
- CAST5-CBC cipher \(legacy, no authentication\)
- SHA-1 digest \(deprecated\)
- Deprecated crypto.createCipher API

The new implementation will be added in subsequent commits.

BREAKING CHANGE: Complete rewrite of encryption module

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
feat: add modern crypto module with AES-256-GCM

Implements secure encryption using Node.js native crypto module:

Security features \(v2 format\):
- AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption \(confidentiality + integrity\)
- 600,000 PBKDF2-SHA256 iterations \(OWASP 2024 recommendation\)
- 64-byte random salt per encryption \(prevents rainbow tables\)
- 12-byte random IV per file \(native GCM size\)
- Authentication tags to detect tampering

Backward compatibility \(v1 format\):
- Detects legacy encrypted.json files \(no version/salt fields\)
- Supports decryption with old CAST5-CBC/1000 iterations/static salt
- Users can decrypt old files, then re-encrypt to upgrade to v2

API:
- encryptData\(data, key\) - encrypt with AES-256-GCM
- decryptData\(encData, key, iv, tag\) - decrypt v2 format
- decryptLegacyData\(encData, key\) - decrypt v1 format
- deriveKey\(password, salt\) - PBKDF2 key derivation \(v2\)
- deriveLegacyKey\(password\) - PBKDF2 with static salt \(v1\)
- getPassword\(provided?\) - prompt or use provided password
- isLegacyFormat\(encrypted\) - detect v1 vs v2 format

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
feat: modernize CLI with password flag for CI/CD

Simplify CLI from 212 lines to 28 lines:

- Remove deprecated options \(algorithm, salt, iterations, keylen, digest\)
  These are now hardcoded to secure defaults - no footguns
- Keep -p, --password flag for CI/CD automation
- Update commander usage to modern destructured import
- Remove verbose JSDoc comments \(code is self-documenting now\)
- Remove security warning about password flag \(documented in README instead\)

Commands:
- multi-encrypt encrypt|enc [-p password]
- multi-encrypt decrypt|dec [-p password]

The password flag enables automation in CI/CD pipelines:
  multi-encrypt dec -p "$SECRETS_PASSWORD"

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
